slides.heading: What it is
paras: Blender MCP is a Model Context Protocol server that exposes Blender as a set of tools an LLM can call.

slides.heading: What a pro would do that you didn't ask for
paras: A 3D generalist would match the camera first: recover focal length and camera pose from the reference photo with fSpy, set real-world units, and build to that camera instead of guessing a layout.
